legal_hours.rule: Half an hour before sunrise to half an hour after sunset.

seasons.note: WMU A archery closes one week earlier than the rest of the state.
Youth hunters only, with a licensed adult.

definitions.antlered: A deer with at least one antler 3 inches or longer.
definitions.any: Any deer, regardless of sex or age.

method_notes.crossbow: Crossbows are NOT allowed during regular archery season in WMUs A, B, C1, C2 or D1 (only in D2W, G1, G2, H1, H2, I1, I2, J1, J2, K, L, M). Muzzleloader license holders may use a crossbow during muzzleloader season statewide.
method_notes.bag: Each regular, archery or combination license covers one deer. A Special Archery Deer Permit adds one antlered deer.
method_notes.registration: Register within 24 hours. Online registration is unavailable the first 2 days of muzzleloader season and first 3 days of firearms season.
method_notes.baiting: Deer baiting is allowed Oct 21 - Nov 18 in WMUs A through L, with further restrictions, and is banned on some lands (refuges, many state lands without a permit).
